about: Rising Cut (katana.k_bl, the backstep light), milestone-1 task 76: Attack1H05_R's cut from low behind the right hip up across to above the left shoulder, one-handed, off the back foot after a backstep: the back (right) foot pushing up level with the front as the body sinks into the clip's dip and the blade drops low behind (source frames 0-6.8 over 11), the front (left) foot lunging forward as the cut rises through the active frames (13-14.5) and the body comes up out of the dip, the back foot closing up behind into the guard's stance; the clip's second, level cut compressed into the recovery, back in the guard by the settle at 30. One-handed, as the owner chose for the lights (Oct 8); the blade starts and ends 45 degrees lower, as the one-handed guard carries it. Source frames at 30 fps from 0.
